Thus, when heaven and earth first took form, and humans and things became clearly defined, the matter of calculation and numbers arose. The records state that Danao created the sexagenary cycle (jiazi), while Lishou created numerical systems. Once these two were established, they served as a standard for days and governed all matters. One, ten, hundred, thousand, ten-thousand—these are commonly used; the laws of pitch pipes (lv), measurements of length (du), units of capacity (liang), standards of weight (heng), and the calendar (li) are their specialized uses. Therefore, for objects with varying lengths, they are measured using du; for things in different quantities, they are received and measured by liang; for volumes with varying weights, balance is achieved using the standard of weight (quanheng); For sounds that are clear or muddied, harmony is achieved through pitch pipes and their tones (lvlu). The movement of the three lights—the sun, moon, and stars—is recorded through calendar calculations: only then can hidden conditions and subtle changes be comprehensively understood. |
| 3 打開字典顯示相似段落 | 律歷上: | 漢興，北平侯張蒼首治律曆。孝武正樂，置協律之官。至元始中，博徵通知鍾律者，考其意義，羲和劉歆典領條奏，前史班固取以為志。而元帝時，郎中京房房字君明知五聲之音，六律之數。上使太子太傅韋玄成、字少翁諫議大夫章，雜試問房於樂府。房對：「受學故小黃令焦延壽。六十律相生之法：以上生下，皆三生二，以下生上，皆三生四，陽下生陰，陰上生陽，終於中呂，而十二律畢矣。中呂上生執始，執始下生去滅，上下相生，終於南事，六十律畢矣。夫十二律之變至於六十，猶八卦之變至於六十四也。宓羲作易，紀陽氣之初，以為律法。建日冬至之聲，以黃鍾為宮，太蔟為商，姑洗為角，林鍾為徵，南呂為羽，應鍾為變宮，蕤賓為變徵。此聲氣之元，五音之正也。故各終一日。其餘以次運行，當日者各自為宮，而商徵以類從焉。禮運篇曰『五聲、六律、十二管還相為宮』，此之謂也。以六十律分期之日，黃鍾自冬至始，及冬至而復，陰陽寒燠風雨之占生焉。於以檢攝群音，考其高下，苟非草木之聲，則無不有所合。虞書曰『律和聲』，此之謂也。」房又曰：「竹聲不可以度調，故作準以定數。準之狀如瑟，長丈而十三弦，隱閒九尺，以應黃鍾之律九寸；中央一弦，下有畫分寸，以為六十律清濁之節。」房言律詳於歆所奏，其術施行於史官，候部用之。文多不悉載。故總其本要，以續前志。 |
| | | When the Han dynasty rose to power, Beiping Hou Zhang Cang was the first to oversee pitch pipes and calendars. Emperor Xiaowu regulated music and established the office of Xielv (Harmonizing Pitch). By the Yuan Shi period, widely recruiting those knowledgeable in bells and pitch pipes, examining their meanings, Xihe Liu Xin was appointed to oversee and submit detailed reports; previous historian Ban Gu adopted these as records. During the reign of Emperor Yuan, Langzhong Jing Fang (courtesy name Junming) understood the five tones and the six pitch pipe numbers. The emperor ordered Taizi Taifu Wei Xuancheng (courtesy name Shaoweng), Jianyi Dafu Zhang, and others to test Jing Fang at the Music Bureau. Fang replied: "I received my learning from former Xiahuang Ling Jiao Yanshou. The method of generating the sixty pitch pipes: when generating downward from above, each is two-thirds; when generating upward from below, each is four-thirds. Yang generates Yin downward, and Yin generates Yang upward, ending at Zhonglu, thus completing the twelve pitch pipes. Zhonglu generates upward to Zhishi, Zhishi generates downward to Qumie; generating alternately up and down, ending at Nanshi, thus completing the sixty pitch pipes. The transformation of the twelve pitch pipes reaching sixty is similar to how the eight trigrams transform into sixty-four hexagrams. Fuxi created the Yijing, recording the beginning of yang energy as a basis for pitch pipe laws. On the day of winter solstice, the sound is established with Huangzhong as gong (palace), Taicu as shang (merchant), Guxian as jue (angle), Linzhong as zhi (sharp), Nanlu as yu (feather), Yingzhong as bian gong (variant palace), and Ruibin as bian zhi (variant sharp). This is the origin of sound and energy, and the correct five tones. Therefore, each lasts for one day. The rest follow in sequence; on the corresponding days, they each become gong, with shang and zhi following accordingly. The Lüyun pian says: "the five tones, six pitch pipes, twelve tubes reciprocally serve as gong"—this is what it refers to. Using the sixty pitch pipes to correspond with days of the year, Huangzhong begins at winter solstice and returns again at winter solstice; thus arise omens concerning yin-yang, cold-heat, wind-rain. Through this method, all sounds are examined and their pitch levels assessed; if not the sound of grass or trees, there is nothing that does not correspond. The Yu Shu says: "Pitch pipes harmonize sounds"—this is what it means." Fang also said, "The sound of bamboo cannot be tuned by measurements alone; therefore, a standard (zhun) is made to determine the numbers. The zhun resembles a se, one zhang in length with thirteen strings; its sounding length is nine chi to correspond to the Huangzhong pitch pipe's nine cun; the central string has markings in cun and fen below it, serving as markers for the sixty pitch pipes' clear or muddied tones." Fang's detailed discussion of pitch pipes was included in Liu Xin's submitted report; the method was implemented by historians and used by the Office of Observing Officials. The text is extensive, so it cannot be fully recorded here. Therefore, I summarize its essentials to continue the previous records. |
| 4 打開字典顯示相似段落 | 律歷上: | 律術曰：陽以圓為形，其性動。陰以方為節，其性靜。動者數三，靜者數二。以陽生陰，倍之；以陰生陽，四之：皆三而一。陽生陰曰下生，陰生陽曰上生。上生不得過黃鍾之清濁，下生不得及黃鍾之數實。皆參天兩地，圓蓋方覆，六耦承奇之道也。黃鍾，律呂之首，而生十一律者也。其相生也，皆三分而損益之。是故十二律之，得十七萬七千一百四十七，是為黃鍾之實。又以二乘而三約之，是為下生林鍾之實。又以四乘而三約之，是為上生太蔟之實。推此上下，以定六十律之實。以九三之，數萬九千六百八十三為法。律為寸，於準為尺。不盈者十之，所得為分。又不盈十之，所得為小分。以其餘正其強弱。 |
| | | The method of pitch pipes says: Yang takes a round form; its nature is active. Yin takes square as its measure; its nature is still. The active corresponds to the number three, and the still corresponds to the number two. When generating Yin from Yang, double it; when generating Yang from Yin, multiply by four: all are three to one. Generating Yin from Yang is called "sheng xia" (generating downward), and generating Yang from Yin is called "sheng shang" (generating upward). Generating upward must not exceed the clarity or muddiness of Huangzhong, and generating downward must not fall short of the numerical value of Huangzhong. All these involve three heavens and two earths, round covering above and square beneath, following the principle of six pairs supporting the odd number. Huangzhong is the first pitch pipe among the twelve, from which the other eleven pitch pipes are generated. Their generation follows a method of dividing into three parts and adjusting by adding or subtracting portions. Therefore, the twelve pitch pipes yield 177,147, which is the actual value of Huangzhong. Multiplying this by two and dividing by three yields the actual value for Linzhong, which is generated downward from Huangzhong. Multiplying it by four and dividing by three gives the actual value of Taicu, which is generated upward. Following this principle of generating up and down determines the actual values for the sixty pitch pipes. Using 93 as a divisor, the number becomes 19,683. Pitch pipes are measured in cun; on the zhun (standard), they correspond to chi. If it does not reach a whole number, multiply by ten; what is obtained becomes fen. If still incomplete, multiply again by ten; the result is called xiaofen (small fen). Use its remainder to determine strength or weakness. |

| | | Huangzhong: 177,14７. Generates downward to Linzhong. Huangzhong is gong, Taicu shang, and Linzhong zhi. One day. Pitch pipe: nine cun. Zhuun (standard): nine chi. |
| 6 打開字典顯示相似段落 | 律歷上: | 色育，十七萬六千七百七十六。下生謙待。色育為宮，未知商，謙待徵。六日。律，八寸九分小分八微強。準，八尺九寸萬五千九百七十三。執始，十七萬四千七百六十二。下生去滅。執始為宮，時息商，去滅徵。六日。律，八寸八分小分七大強。準，八尺八寸萬五千五百一十六。丙盛，十七萬二千四百一十。下生安度。丙盛為宮，屈齊商，安度徵。六日。律，八寸七分小分六微弱。準，八尺七寸萬一千六百七十九。分動，十七萬八十九。下生歸嘉。分動為宮，隨期商，歸嘉徵。六日。律，八寸六分小分四強。準，八尺六寸八千一百五十二。質末，十六萬七千八百。下生否與。質末為宮，形晉商，否與徵。六日。律，八寸五分小分二強。準，八尺五寸四千九百四十五。大呂，十六萬五千八百八十八。下生夷則。大呂為宮，夾鍾商，夷則徵。 |

Zhuun (standard): eight chi, nine cun, 15,973. Zhishi: 174,762. Generates downward to Qumie. Zhishi is gong, Shixi shang, and Qumie zhi. Six days. Pitch pipe: eight cun, eight fen, xiaofen seven, and a large amount more. Zhuun (standard): eight chi, eight cun, 155,516. Bingsheng: 172,410. Generates downward to Andu. Bingsheng is gong, Quqi shang, and Andu zhi. Six days. Pitch pipe: eight cun, seven fen, xiaofen six, and slightly less. Zhuun (standard): eight chi, seven cun, 116,79. Fendong: 170,89. Generates downward to Guijia. Fendong is gong, Suqi shang, and Guijia zhi. Six days. Pitch pipe: eight cun, six fen, xiaofen four and a bit more. Zhuun (standard): eight chi, six cun, 8152. Zhimo: 167,800. Generates downward to Piyu. Zhimo is gong, Xingjin shang, and Piyu zhi. Six days. Pitch pipe: eight cun, five fen, xiaofen two and a bit more. Zhuun (standard): eight chi, five cun, 4945. Dalu: 165,888. Generates downward to Yize. Dalu is gong, Jiazhong shang, and Yize zhi. |
| 7 打開字典顯示相似段落 | 律歷上: | 八日。律，八寸四分小分三弱。準，八尺四寸五千五百八。分否，十六萬三千六百五十四。下生解形。分否為宮，開時商，解形徵。八日。律，八寸三分小分一強。準，八尺三寸二千八百五十一。凌陰，十六萬一千四百五十二。下生去南。凌陰為宮，族嘉商，去南徵。八日。律，八寸二分小分一弱。準，八尺二寸五百一十四。少出，十五萬九千二百八十。下生分積。少出為宮，爭南商，分積徵。六日。律，八寸小分九強。準，八尺萬八千一百六十。太蔟，十五萬七千四百六十四。下生南呂。太蔟為宮，姑洗商，南呂徵。一日。律，八寸。準，八尺。未知，十五萬七千一百三十四。下生白呂。未知為宮，南授商，白呂徵。六日。律，七寸九分小分八強。準，七尺九寸萬六千三百八十三。時息，十五萬五千三百四十四。 |
